name: Blue Mountain Day Camp
operator_name: Fairview Lake YMCA Camps (Metropolitan YMCA of the Oranges)
street_address: Fairview Lake YMCA Camps, 1035 Fairview Lake Road
description_short: Coed YMCA day camp on the Fairview Lake YMCA Camps property in Stillwater for ages 3 to 15, grouped from Turtles (age 3 to entering kindergarten) to Pioneers (entering grades 7 to 9). Campers take daily swim lessons in the lake and choose weekly clubs such as sailing, climbing, fishing, paddleboarding, hiking and survival skills.

fees.name: Bus transportation
fees.note: Two week Sessions 2 to 5; $79 for the one week Session 1. Three routes across Sussex County.

fees.name: Before care
fees.note: Two week Sessions 2 to 5; $47 for Session 1. Drop off from 7:30 a.m.

fees.name: After care
fees.note: Two week Sessions 2 to 5; $47 for Session 1. Pick up until 6 p.m.

fees.name: Trail rides
fees.note: Optional week of trail rides at the Fairview Lake Ranch, Pathfinders and Pioneers only

swim_waterfront_notes: Daily swim lessons and an afternoon free swim in Fairview Lake, staffed by American Red Cross waterfront lifeguards and supervised by a Water Safety Instructor. Campers are swim tested on the first day.

sessions.name: Counselor in Training (3 weeks, ages 15 and up)

notes: Prices are the regular Summer Rate from April 1, 2027. Early Bird through January 31, 2027 is $390 (one week) and $705 (two weeks); Spring Saver, February 1 to March 31, is $402 and $726. CIT is $1,080 early bird, $1,112 spring, $1,135 regular. Camp runs 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.; campers must be potty trained. Campers pack a lunch; the Trading Post sells snacks.
